name_ja: たのしみグローバルⅢ（指数連動プラン）
policy_name_ja: 5年ごと利差配当付選択通貨建個人年金保険（一時払い）（23）
policy_names_ja: 5年ごと利差配当付選択通貨建個人年金保険（一時払い）（23）
5年ごと利差配当付指定通貨建個人年金保険（一時払い）（20）
notes: Index-linked sibling of the fixed-rate plan sml-tanoshimi-global-3-teiritsu; same policy forms (23)/(20), same 5-year and 10-year 据置期間 and 目標額設定なし / あり choice, same rate site (A871) with type=idx instead of type=fix.

Metrics: 連動率 (participation rate, participation_rate) is applied to the yearly rise of the linked index to give the 積立金 growth rate; it can exceed 100% and the published figure is not a crediting rate. 積立利率 (crediting_rate) applies after a transfer to 定率積立 and in similar cases (rate page note). 市場価格調整用利率 (mva_rate) is also collected. No cap or floor figure is published on the rate site.

The index itself (指数推移表, 指数グラフ, 指数の騰落率・積立金の増加率) is on the rate site but is an index level history, not a product rate; it is not collected. Which index is linked has not been read from the brochure (brochures are not downloaded).
Rate history on the site starts with the 責任開始日 period 2023-06-16 to 06-30, the same as the fixed-rate plan.
effective_date is the first day of the 責任開始日 period (half-month, rates set on the 1st and 16th); the site's 契約日 about a month later is not stored. Same convention for 連動率, 積立利率 and the MVA rate.
円建 is not offered with 目標額設定あり (stored as not_offered). 円建 5年 under JPY 3 million is not accepted when 積立利率 is below 0.45%. A dash on the site means the currency was suspended in that period.

Channels: chid=cgin is the general rate page. The closed Mizuho Bank edition (product page tanoshimiglobal3_shisuu_mizuho.html) links chid=mzho, but that chid returns only a redirect page to the insurer's general page (checked 2026-11-17), so no separate Mizuho rates exist; chid=cgin is the only rate page. Channel history not collected.

Distributors: the general list is as of 2026-10-01 from the finance page (sources/sml/pages/distributors_2026-11-16.html, section たのしみグローバルⅢ（指数連動プラン）), 41 institutions. The Mizuho Bank edition is closed to new business (its page says 新規のご契約のお取扱いはしておりません and the lineup page lists it under 現在お取り扱いしていない商品), so みずほ銀行 is recorded as an off-sale edition, not a current distributor; its off-sale date is not established. Corrected by the independent checker on 2026-11-17.

Launch date: 2023-06-16, the sales start stated in the insurer's news release of 2023-06-09 (一時払個人年金保険「たのしみグローバルⅢ（指数連動プラン）」「たのしみグローバルⅢ（定率増加プラン）」, sold at SMBC and SMBC Nikko Securities as 「たのしみステップⅢ」 for the 指数連動プラン). It follows 「たのしみグローバルⅡ」 (on sale from 2020-10), to which the Ⅲ edition added a yen option. Retrieved 2026-11-17.
notes_en: Rate history starts on 16 June 2023; dates are the start of the period in which cover begins.
The published figure is a participation rate applied to the yearly rise in the linked index; it can exceed 100%, and no cap or floor is published.
Which index is linked has not been read, and index data is not collected.
The Mizuho Bank edition is closed to new business; the other distributors share the same rates, and the yen option is not offered with a target.

With a target set, the crediting rate the insurer publishes for this plan is the same as the fixed-rate plan's in every period held (checked against both saved rate pages); without a target the two differ in some periods.

verification.method: An independent parser (scripts/recheck_candidates_a.py, not the collector's) compared 796 rows with their saved snapshots and all matched: a seeded random sample of 252 of 2490 published rows (10% of each rate CSV, at least 20), every outlier (52: a value more than 3 standard deviations from its series mean, a move of more than 1pp between consecutive periods, or a value outside 0-15%; 10pp and 0-300% for participation rates) and every not_offered row (498). A follow-up pass over every row also matched.
verification.note: Rows with a retrieved_date after verified_through have not been re-checked.
